judgment_candidates.judgment: NVIDIA remains the main external accelerator system bottleneck because GB200 is a rack-scale system, but AMD MI300/MI35x and Google TPU are real workload-specific substitutes.
judgment_candidates.business_mechanism: Product evidence should be read as architecture, performance and adoption evidence, not as SKU revenue. The graph must connect GB200 -> Dell/Google cloud deployment, AMD -> memory-heavy competition, and TPU -> custom-silicon substitution.
judgment_candidates.cannot_infer: Cannot infer SKU revenue, share, shipment, ASP or margin from specs/benchmarks/cloud surfaces.
judgment_candidates.counter_read: If AMD/TPU production deployments broaden or GB200 deployment slips, NVIDIA pricing and allocation power weakens.
what_would_change_view: Production deployments, procurement mix and pricing evidence would change the weight.

judgment_candidates.judgment: Dell has unusually visible AI server revenue demand, but the investment-quality question is margin conversion, not whether demand exists.
judgment_candidates.business_mechanism: The right bridge is orders/backlog -> shipments -> ISG revenue -> gross/operating margin -> cash conversion. Current public rows prove the first half and leave AI server mix, GPU pass-through and attach economics unresolved.

what_would_change_view: Improving ISG margin with backlog conversion and attach economics would strengthen Dell quality.
